verdict.rationale: GitHub docs confirm a public-code matching feature that flags when a suggestion matches existing public repositories (github-copilot-docs-11), giving leads some visibility into provenance. However, there is no evidence the tool surfaces specific license information per match, and community reports (e.g., github-copilot-comm-12, -13, -14) describe verbatim/GPL code slipping through and warn that the matching safeguard is not fully reliable for license-risk review.
